basis: Voluntary employee turnover rate in % (UBS Group; Gesamtfluktuation inkl. unfreiwilliger & neutraler Austritte in `gross`)
source: UBS Group Sustainability Report Supplement 2024 (p. 32) & 2025 (GRI 401-1: Voluntary and involuntary employee turnover)

2022.note: Voluntary turnover 12,6 %; Involuntary turnover 2,5 %; Overall turnover 15,9 % (Frauen 15,4 %, Männer 16,2 %; Director+ 10,9 %)

2023.note: Voluntary turnover 12,4 %; Involuntary turnover 5,3 %; Overall turnover 18,6 % im Zuge der CS-Übernahme (Frauen 18,7 %, Männer 18,6 %)

2024.note: Voluntary turnover 7,9 %; Involuntary turnover 4,1 %; Overall turnover 12,8 % (Frauen 13,3 %, Männer 12,5 %; Director+ 12,3 %)

2025.note: Voluntary turnover 7,1 %; Involuntary turnover 4,9 %; Overall turnover 12,6 % (UBS Sustainability Report Supplement 2025)
